messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: QBR synthesis: field lens & account teams

Team —

As we lock the QBR slate next week I want a concise, uniform rollup we can push to Exec and GTM ops by EOD Wednesday. Goal: one slide summary per key account (top 12 by ARR / risk) plus a single consolidated forecast that ties to commit.

Ask (owners in parens):
- Account one-pagers using the attached template: current ARR, next 90-day milestones, risks & mitigations, forecast category (commit/likely/upside) (owner: account AE)
- Consolidated forecast: delta vs last quarter commit + rationale for movement (owner: Aditya)
- Highlight 2 accounts where we should consider routing to Dedicated/Private for early renewal motion (owner: Marcus)
- Quick ops note on gating items requiring Customer Success / Security sign-off (owner: Tessa)

Attachments: QBR_pipeline_master_v3.xlsx (master sheet), account_one_pager_template.docx. Please populate the master sheet with a single-line forecast reason per account and attach the one-pager for each.

Timeline: drafts by EOD Tuesday (2026-06-02), consolidated deck for leadership review by 10:00 AM Wednesday (2026-06-03). If any account needs a pre-brief with me, flag it in the master sheet and ping me directly.

Thanks — let's keep these tight and actionable.

—Laura
Laura Bennett

Thanks all — great traction. Final notes before I push to Exec: 

1) Aditya: convert the snapshot into the Exec-ready table (one row per account, ARR / forecast category / 90-day action / owner) and indicate variance vs last commit in a +/- column.
2) Marcus: leave the Dedicated pilot recommendation in the one-pager for Acme; we will present as an option but mark revenue as Upside unless we see a signed LOI.
3) Tessa: add a two-line mitigation for each high-risk account and one ask per account for CS support.

Marta — appreciate the quick confirmation on the procurement checklist if you can. If you prefer, we can set a 20-min sync Thursday to walk the file.

I’ll assemble the deck first thing Thursday morning and circulate to the exec group by 9:00 AM PT. If there are any last-minute changes, put them in the Drive sheet and notify me via Slack.

Attachments: consolidated deck will include the one-pagers attached; see master sheet in Drive.
